title: Data-loss-prevention enforcement at the egress boundary
summary: In-line DLP enforcement at the egress boundary (web proxy, mail gateway, cloud-storage broker) inspects payloads against the operator's data-classification policy and blocks, quarantines, or alerts on sensitive-data movement out of the protected boundary.

component.title: DLP enforcement service (egress)
component.description: Egress DLP broker enforcing data-classification policy on outbound traffic.

control-implementations.description: Implements information-flow enforcement at the egress boundary.

implemented-requirements.description: Information flow enforcement: egress DLP blocks unauthorised flows by classification.
Boundary protection: DLP enforcement is one of the boundary controls applied to outbound traffic.

sources: NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555, Article 21(2)(d) — supply-chain and information-flow controls
ENISA — Threat Landscape, data-exfiltration mitigation guidance
